name: junkd
description: One plugin for handoff, orch, tldr, ctx-limit, ctx-tokens, the status line and the tools pane, plus the /junkd frame. /junkd:handoff saves a session handoff and /junkd:handon <id> resumes it; /junkd:ahandoff hands off automatically at a context threshold and resumes after the 5h rate limit. /junkd:orch runs the orchestration loop (/junkd:orch-init writes its .orch/config.md); the hooks module guards the main loop on Fable. /junkd:direction scores the code against the spec files the config names and lists the drift for a human decision. /junkd:lessons shows the pending orch lessons (local, repo and global stores) to promote, drop or move up; an orch run does not end while one is pending. /junkd:tldr N summarizes, /junkd:tldr on|off keeps every reply terse. /junkd:ctx-limit sets a context-size limit a prompt hook enforces (block, warn or a command); /junkd:ctx-tokens reads the live context usage. /junkd:statusline wires a colored status line (context, branch, worktree, model, effort, rate limits; each segment a setting) into settings.json. /junkd:tools opens the tools pane: this session's agents over the repo's git worktrees, and the tools, MCP servers and skills the session used. /junkd (and the ✚ junkd segment under the prompt) opens the junkd, handoff, orch, statusline, tools and lessons tabs together: the marketplace's plugins, every setting group (core, handoff, orch, tldr, ctx, statusline, tools) and the commands. The hooks module exports $.junkd for other mods.

core_output_style.title: Output style
core_output_style.description: At session start, once per plugin version: make junkd:STE (Simplified Technical English) the output style when ~/.claude/settings.json has no outputStyle yet. off skips the step; a style you chose is never touched either way.

core_cache_check_sessions.title: Cache check: sessions read
core_cache_check_sessions.description: Prompt-cache check at every main session start (not after a compaction): scripts/cache-check.sh reads the usage lines of the newest N sessions of the project (and their subagents) and shows one suggestion above the prompt when a threshold is hit. A whole number 0-30; 0 turns the check off.

handoff_enabled.title: Auto handoff: enabled
handoff_enabled.description: Off: no auto handoff at all (no threshold check, no 5h-limit resume, no 🪃 segment); /junkd:handoff, /junkd:handon and the pane still work.

handoff_threshold.title: Auto handoff: context threshold (thousand tokens)
handoff_threshold.description: Past this many thousand tokens of context (300 = 300k) the auto handoff kicks in (handoff → /clear → /junkd:handon → continue). 100 or less is read as a percent of the window (old configs).

handoff_checkEvery.title: Auto handoff: check every N tool calls
handoff_checkEvery.description: How often, in tool calls, the context usage is read mid-turn.

handoff_autoOn.title: Auto handoff: armed at session start
handoff_autoOn.description: Start every session with the auto handoff loop armed.

handoff_resumeAfterLimit.title: Auto handoff: resume after the 5h rate limit
handoff_resumeAfterLimit.description: When an armed loop's turn dies on the 5-hour limit, send the continuation prompt 2 minutes after the window resets.

handoff_staleDays.title: Handoffs: mark stale after N days
handoff_staleDays.description: Handoffs older than this are drawn as stale in the pane and removed by Delete stale.

handoff_segment.title: Status line: show the 🪃 segment
handoff_segment.description: Show the context percentage segment in the prompt hint line; a click opens the pane.

orch_enabled.title: Orchestrator: enabled
orch_enabled.description: Off: no main-loop guard and no rule sheet at session start, whatever guard and inject_rules say; /junkd:orch still runs when you ask for it.

orch_guard.title: Main-loop guard
orch_guard.description: When the main loop is held to planning and delegating: on a Fable model, always, or never.

orch_allow_fable_agents.title: Allow Fable subagents
orch_allow_fable_agents.description: Let the main loop spawn a subagent on an explicit Fable model (the person asked for it).

orch_implementer_ctx_k.title: Implementer context cap (k tokens)
orch_implementer_ctx_k.description: Reuse an implementer for a fix round only while its context is under this many thousand tokens.

orch_ui_review.title: UI review
orch_ui_review.description: Run ui-reviewer on the UI criteria when the project config declares a web capability; off, they become PM-REVIEW rows.

orch_inject_rules.title: Inject orchestrator rules
orch_inject_rules.description: Print ORCHESTRATOR.md into the main session at session start (the SessionStart hook).

orch_rounds.title: Fix rounds
orch_rounds.description: Fix rounds per task; --rounds overrides it for one run.

orch_claude_md.title: CLAUDE.md pointer block
orch_claude_md.description: On: the "## Orchestrator mode" section of ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (with its ### children) becomes a short block pointing at /junkd:orch, between <!-- junkd:orch start --> and <!-- junkd:orch end -->. Off: the block is removed. CLAUDE.md is backed up before each change; off never puts the old section back (the backup holds it). Applied at once and at every session start while orch is enabled.

orch_dashboard_refresh.title: Dashboard: write every N seconds
orch_dashboard_refresh.description: While the orch dashboard is open (/junkd:dashboard), status.js beside the page is written again every N seconds (5-600, clamped), as well as at each spawn, agent end and turn end.

orch_dashboard_window_h.title: Dashboard: timeline window (hours)
orch_dashboard_window_h.description: The hours the dashboard's timeline shows, ending now (1-168, clamped).

orch_watchdog.title: Agent watchdog
orch_watchdog.description: Watch this session's agents (no tokens: engine hooks and a 30 s timer): a stall, a death and an idle leftover each raise a toast once; a death or a stall also shows ⚠ under the prompt and one line for the orchestrator at the next turn. Off while orch is disabled.

orch_idle_stop.title: Watchdog: stop idle leftovers
orch_idle_stop.description: Stop an agent that reported and is still alive when it will not be needed again (a reviewer at once, an implementer once its task is done or blocked, anything else after the idle minutes). Off: they are reported only.

orch_idle_stop_minutes.title: Watchdog: idle minutes before a stop
orch_idle_stop_minutes.description: Minutes a finished agent with no task in progress may stay idle before it is stopped. A value under 1 is read as 1, one over 120 as 120.

orch_stall_minutes.title: Watchdog: stall after N minutes
orch_stall_minutes.description: Minutes a running agent may go without a tool call (none in flight) before it counts as stalled; a reviewer gets 5 more. A value under 1 is read as 1, one over 120 as 120.

orch_lessons.title: Lessons loop
orch_lessons.description: On: the lessons of the three stores (.orch/tasks/_lessons.md, the repo's lessons.md, ~/.claude/junkd/lessons.md) whose stack meets the repo's are injected at an orch session's start, pending ones show the 📒 segment and the lessons tab, and an orch run does not end while any is pending. Off: none of that, and the files are left as they are.

tldr_enabled.title: TL;DR: enabled
tldr_enabled.description: Off: the per-turn terse hook stays silent whatever terse mode says; /junkd:tldr N still summarizes.

tldr_terse.title: Terse mode
tldr_terse.description: Keep every reply terse, in all sessions, until off: the same switch as /junkd:tldr on|off. The flag file ~/.claude/junkd/tldr-on is what the per-turn hook reads.

tldr_sentences.title: Sentences in a summary
tldr_sentences.description: How many sentences a /junkd:tldr without a number may use.

ctx_enabled.title: Context limit: enabled
ctx_enabled.description: On: the per-prompt hook (bin/ctx-limit-hook) acts once the session's context passes the threshold. The file ~/.claude/junkd/ctx-limit-threshold, there while on, is what the hook reads; /junkd:ctx-limit on|off|<tokens> is the same switch.

ctx_threshold.title: Context limit: threshold (tokens)
ctx_threshold.description: The context size, in tokens, past which the action applies. A whole number, 1000 or more; 300k and 1m are read too.

ctx_action.title: Context limit: action past it
ctx_action.description: block: the prompt is refused until /clear, /junkd:handoff or /junkd:ctx-limit off; warn: a warning goes into the context and the prompt runs; cmd: the command below runs (CTX_TOKENS and CTX_LIMIT set) and the prompt runs.

ctx_cmd.title: Context limit: command of action cmd
ctx_cmd.description: The shell command action cmd runs past the threshold, e.g. a desktop notification.

statusline_enabled.title: Status line: wired into settings.json
statusline_enabled.description: On: ~/.claude/settings.json's statusLine points at ~/.claude/junkd/statusline.sh (a copy of bin/statusline.sh, refreshed when the plugin updates). A statusLine of your own is never replaced: turning this on refuses with the reason. Off removes the statusLine key only while it is junkd's.

statusline_ctx.title: Segment: context free/used
statusline_ctx.description: Draw context free and used, in tokens and percent in the status line.

statusline_branch.title: Segment: git branch
statusline_branch.description: Draw the git branch (or the detached commit) in the status line.

statusline_worktree.title: Segment: linked worktree
statusline_worktree.description: Draw the linked worktree's folder, only inside one in the status line.

statusline_model.title: Segment: model
statusline_model.description: Draw the model's name in the status line.

statusline_effort.title: Segment: effort
statusline_effort.description: Draw the effort level in the status line.

statusline_limits.title: Segment: 5h/week rate limits
statusline_limits.description: Draw the 5-hour and weekly rate-limit use, colored by how full in the status line.

tools_enabled.title: Tools pane: enabled
tools_enabled.description: Off: the tools pane closes, its tab leaves the /junkd set, /junkd:tools says it is off and no tool, MCP or skill use is counted.

tools_refresh.title: Tools pane: refresh every N seconds
tools_refresh.description: Seconds between two reads of the agents, the worktrees and the MCP schemas while the tools pane is open. A value under 10 is read as 10, one over 600 as 600.

tools_agents_only.title: Tools pane: only worktrees with an agent
tools_agents_only.description: The Agents tab hides the worktrees that hold no agent of this session (the main checkout stays).
